product_metadata.title: Anti Allergy Dirt Pillow Cases | Irritant Protector | Premium Breathable Smooth Surface Cover | 100% Waterproof | Zippered Encasement | Set of 2 | Toddler Travel Size
features: MACHINE WASHABLE Wash in your machine without fabric softener or bleach. Tumble dry on low
100% WATERPROOF Repel all liquids - spills, body fluids, sweat. Keep your pillows clean
EASY TO PUT ON AND TAKE OFF - Just slide on and zip up! Does a great job of covering the fluffiest pillows on all sides with zippered protection.
MATERIAL IS NOISELESS -  Does a great job at protecting without making a sound. Exactly what you need to sleep quietly in safety. You'll be very happy with your purchase.

EASY TO WASH AND MAINTAIN - Easy to wash and dry in the washing machine and tumble dryer (low heat). They will continue to do a great job of protecting your pillows after several washes as long as you follow instructions.
